## Original article text

````markdown
## Description
Used in [Create In-World Text](/wiki/articles/create+in-world+text), [Create Progress Bar In-World Text](/wiki/articles/create+progress+bar+in-world+text), [Create HUD Text](/wiki/articles/create+hud+text) and [Create Progress Bar HUD Text](/wiki/articles/create+progress+bar+hud+text). Whether non-team spectators can see the text or not.

## Options
- **Default Visibility** 
  - Non-team spectators can see text when all players can see it.
- **Visible Always** 
  - Non-team spectators can always see text.
- **Visible Never** 
  - Non-team spectators can never see text.
````
